title: AutomationConfig
description: Optional tuning in config/automation.yaml. Never contains credentials.

plan_horizon_days.description: rolling calendar: cadence slots this far ahead are reserved and filled with candidates (LCE-049)

freshness_lead_hours.description: the freshness window opens this long before a post's slot, leaving time for research, writing, QA and approval

freshness_recheck_hours.description: inside the window, a post is checked again when its last check is older than this

freshness_escalate.description: a stale post automatically gets a same-slot replacement request (never approved or published automatically)
